integrity: Finite exact exhaustive proof based on a demonstrated 2048-symbol factor-completeness reduction, eight explicit lower witnesses and two standalone checkers.
scientific_limitations: All starting positions of the one-sided binary Thue–Morse fixed point, for exactly k=3,...,10; no claim about other k or asymptotic sharpness. Historical priority has not been independently verified.
title: Exact initial uniform antipower radii of the Thue–Morse word
